Sms._comment: Example: https://sms-gateway.example/send?to={to}&text={message}&key=YOUR_KEY. Leave empty to record messages as Simulated.

Inspection._comment: Due dates (MM-dd) for the annual Dam Safety Act inspections — confirm with the State Dam Safety Organisation.

Mqtt._comment: Gateways publish to {TopicRoot}/{damCode}/{gatewayCode}/telemetry and /status; the API acknowledges on /ack. Use TLS (8883) and per-gateway broker credentials + ACLs in production.

Ai._comment: Optional OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint (e.g. a self-hosted model: http://ai-server:8080/v1/chat/completions). Empty = library search returns passages only.

Map._comment: Point TileUrl to an internal tile server for offline / government networks.

Ocr._comment: Needs Tesseract OCR and Poppler (pdftoppm) installed on the server; set full paths on Windows.

Sso._comment: OpenID Connect (Keycloak, Azure AD / Entra ID, ADFS...). Redirect URI to register: https://<site>/api/auth/sso/callback. Users must already exist (matched by e-mail); roles stay in DAM MASTER. With AllowLocalLogin=false only Admins can use passwords (break-glass).

Federation._comment: InstanceKey lets a national / central hub read this instance's portfolio summary. Instances = [{Name, Url, Key}] of state instances this hub aggregates.
